note: Invented prompts for the D3 go/no-go check. positives rewrite a sample document; negatives are on similar topics but are not copies.

positives.doc: Board memo: expansion into the Balkans
positives.text: The management team recommends opening offices in Sofia and Belgrade during the second quarter of 2027. The plan assumes an initial investment of four million euros, financed from retained earnings, with break even expected after twenty two months.

positives.doc: Board memo: expansion into the Balkans
positives.text: Leadership wants to set up new branches in Sofia and Belgrade in Q2 2027. They budget 4 million euros paid out of retained profit and think the project pays for itself in about 22 months.

positives.doc: Board memo: expansion into the Balkans
positives.text: We plan to buy a small Sofia company called Danube Advisory for 1.5 million euros so that we immediately get its banking and telecom customers. Our biggest rival has been talking to two of the same targets.

positives.doc: Board memo: expansion into the Balkans
positives.text: Please summarise this for me: the board will vote in March on whether we expand into Bulgaria and Serbia, and the offer for the Danube firm has to be settled before mid April. Nothing may be discussed outside the executive committee.

positives.doc: Board memo: expansion into the Balkans
positives.text: Η διοίκηση προτείνει να ανοίξουμε γραφεία στη Σόφια και το Βελιγράδι το δεύτερο τρίμηνο του 2027, με αρχική επένδυση τεσσάρων εκατομμυρίων ευρώ.

The agreement runs for three years and renews automatically for periods of one year unless either party gives ninety days written notice. The supplier's liability is limited to the fees paid in the twelve months before a claim, except for breach of confidentiality, which is unlimited.

Our contract with Delphi lasts three years, then rolls over yearly unless someone cancels with 90 days notice. If something goes wrong we only owe what they paid us in the last year, except if we leak their confidential data, where there is no cap.
We charge Delphi Insurance 840,000 euros a year for analytics and regulatory reporting, billed every quarter up front. They can leave after year one by paying half of what is left.

Η σύμβαση με τη Delphi Insurance διαρκεί τρία χρόνια και ανανεώνεται αυτόματα κάθε χρόνο, εκτός αν κάποιο μέρος δώσει γραπτή ειδοποίηση ενενήντα ημερών. Η ευθύνη του προμηθευτή περιορίζεται στις αμοιβές των τελευταίων δώδεκα μηνών.

Για τους προγραμματιστές το εύρος της πρώτης βαθμίδας είναι από είκοσι οκτώ έως τριάντα πέντε χιλιάδες ευρώ ετησίως, της δεύτερης βαθμίδας από τριάντα πέντε έως σαράντα πέντε χιλιάδες και της τρίτης βαθμίδας από σαράντα πέντε έως εξήντα χιλιάδες ευρώ.
Οι μισθοί των developers το 2027 ξεκινούν από 28.000 και φτάνουν τα 60.000 ευρώ τον χρόνο ανάλογα με το επίπεδο, ενώ οι tech leads παίρνουν από 60 έως 80 χιλιάδες.
Το μπόνους απόδοσης δεν επιτρέπεται να υπερβαίνει το 15% του βασικού μισθού και οι αυξήσεις δίνονται μία φορά τον χρόνο τον Ιανουάριο μετά την αξιολόγηση.
Here is what we pay developers in 2027: junior band 28 to 35 thousand euros a year, middle band 35 to 45 thousand, senior band 45 to 60 thousand. Team leads earn between 60 and 80 thousand.
Performance bonuses are capped at fifteen percent of base pay and raises are only approved once a year in January after the review. This must not be shared outside HR and management.

Πώς μπορώ να υπολογίσω το μπόνους απόδοσης ως ποσοστό του ετήσιου μισθού σε ένα λογιστικό φύλλο;
Summarise the main points of the GDPR rules on reporting a personal data breach within seventy two hours.
Give me ideas for the agenda of a quarterly board meeting for a mid sized consulting company.
